page.overview:
Who is Margarita?

Margarita is the owner of the shadow that was inserted into Victoria Cindry's corpse twelve years ago. She currently works as a maid for Egana.

Margarita is a young, average-sized girl with freckles, dark blue eyes and light brown, wavy hair worn in a ponytail. She was seen wearing her working clothes: a maid outfit.

Twelve years ago, Margarita had an intense hatred of plates due to an incident with her former fiancé. This state of her personality was reflected by her shadow while it was possessed by the zombie Cindry.

In the present day, Margarita has managed to overcome her dislike of plates. She seems very humble and emotional, as she starts crying with relief when her employer was not angry with her for breaking his plates.
